text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was like the most dazzling, vivid flash of light in the world.
—Such was our fateful first encounter.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A certain horsegirl in a practice race caught my eye.
In the final stretch, bursting from dead last, she accelerated, and accelerated, and accelerated—

text_block_list.name: Race Participants
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa?!” “Eek?!”
“No way, she's so fast...?!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh——!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She blew past everyone and took the victory...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An explosive burst of speed that left everyone spellbound. Dazzling, intensely vibrant,
and heart-racing running. It was almost like—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa—phew!
...Hmph, that felt pretty good—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho! Over here, please!
We need to go over your feedback for that practice race.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
The result itself was wonderful, but relying too heavily on your explosive burst
is a bad habit. You need to manage the early and middle phases more carefully—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grrr, SHUT UUUUP!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut uuup! Don't boss me around!!
There's no waaaay I'm listening to a single thing you say!!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! S-Sweep...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No, no, nooo! I can't hear youuuuu—!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, geez! What is with everyone?! That wasn't fun at all!
I knew this whole thing was just super boring—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...You there!
What're you staring at me for?!
choice_data_list: Well... I was just thinking it looked like magic—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still entranced, the words slipped out before I could stop myself, making me panic.
Calling it "magic" out of nowhere was probably taking it a bit too far—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Did you just say magic?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You did, didn't you?! You said "magic"! Just now!!
Tell me everything! Right now!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmmh~♪ So sweet~♪ It's sooo deliciooous~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
About an hour later, Sweep Tosho finished off a parfait loaded with chocolate
and whipped cream, smiling with utter satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To explain how we ended up here...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, since we're gonna talk, buy me sweets!
Get me something to eat! Your treat, obviously!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm exhausted from running so much!
Pudding, cake, parfaits—I wanna eat 'em, I wanna eat 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yucky stuff is totally off-limits! It's gotta be super sweeet, super yummy,
and look super pretty too~♪ Now, take me! Huu-rryyy-uuup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, practically dragged outside—here we are.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—So, about what you said earlier. You said my running
looked like magic, right? What did you mean by that?
choice_data_list: Well, that's just honestly how it felt to me...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whaaat! That doesn't make any sense at all!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Jeez. And here I thought I might finally
figure out what the 'magic of racing' is.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Grandma told me.
She said the 'magic of racing was the most amazing of all.'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You don't seem to know, so I'll enlighten you.
I am the genius magical girl, Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'm gonna be a great witch just like Grandma.
...So I wanted to learn how to use the 'magic of racing' as fast as I could.
choice_data_list: ...You want to be able to use magic?
...You want to be able to use magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh, of course I do!
Listen up, okay? Magic is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
NO!! No, no, no, no!!
NO WAAAAYYYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Father
text_block_list.text:
S-Sweepy! There's nothing to dislike! You're so good
at English! Your teacher said you got a perfect score on that hard test—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: NO!! I said no, so I'm not going!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Father
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, how about singing then! Let's go to singing lessons!!
 You won that amazing award last time! I'm sure next time—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOOOO WAAAAAAAAYYYYYYY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, no, because it's so boring! Do this, do that,
everybody's always ordering me around!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I do it well and get praised, it's not fun at aaaaall!!
So I hate it! I don't wanna do it anymore! No, no, nooo!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Look at that face—looks like you're bored of everything under the sun. Here—

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: 『Carpe diem』！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eep... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Well now, smells wonderful, doesn't it? Take a deep breath
and calm down first, my sweet little Sweepy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A pretty flower... But how?! It wasn't there a second ago!!
And yet... What, what, what did you do?! Tell me, Grandma!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Want to know? This right here... is 'magic', Sweepy.
I'm a great witch who can use any spell there is!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's that...?
What is it, what is it?! Sounds so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I wanna try!! —I wanna use magic too!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Is that so? Then come along with me.
I'll give you a very special pointed hat of your own.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
My sweet little Sweepy.
Come, let me teach you all the magic that brings color to life!!
